site.tagline: A private ledger of what your projects report.
site.previewAlt: Control Tower sign-in page: a glass card over a city skyline and the planet.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: The Tower admits one GitHub account: its owner.
signIn.denied: This GitHub account is not the owner. Signed out.
signIn.error: Sign-in did not complete: {reason}. Try again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.lead: Every registered project, what it reported, what was observed, and how fresh it is.

project.lead: What this project reported, what GitHub observed, and what the Tower verified, run by run in seq order.
project.legend: reported: sent by the project's runner · observed: seen on GitHub · verified: a reported result that an observed commit status confirms · imported: loaded from history. Ages count from when the Tower received each fact.

usage.title: Usage
usage.lead: Agent usage of every attempt, as each tool reported it. Nothing is estimated.
usage.legend: — means the tool exposed no number. Counts are tokens as each tool reported them, never estimated.

map.legend: Moving light shows each link's state while the Tower is live. It is not traffic.

states.empty: No project yet. Register the first one.
states.unavailable: The Tower could not read its own database. No number is shown until it can.

register.title: Register a project
register.keyError: Use 2 to 32 characters: a capital letter, then capitals, digits, - or _.
register.staleError: Use a whole number from 1 to 100 000.
register.failed: The project could not be saved. Nothing was stored.

import.title: Import history
import.lead: Upload the JSON Lines file from the history export. Every line is checked before anything is stored, and every stored event is labelled imported.
import.drop: Drop the file here or choose it. Up to 512 KB.
import.empty: The file is empty. Nothing was imported.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 512 KB. Nothing was imported.
import.failed: Stopped at line {line} after {stored} stored. Upload the same file again to finish.
import.reasonContract: not an event of contract v1
import.reasonRun: not the file's one import run

linkRequests.title: Link requests
linkRequests.lead: DEV_OS projects whose developer chose to link them ask here. A project's step events are stored only after you approve it.
linkRequests.unavailable: The link requests could not be read. Nothing is shown until they can.
linkRequests.deleteRequest: Delete this request? This cannot be undone.
linkRequests.deleteProject: Delete this request and project {key}, with every run and step event? This cannot be undone.
linkRequests.declinedDone: Declined. Its next request is refused.
linkRequests.disconnectedDone: Disconnected. Its history stays for the record.
linkRequests.deletedProject: Deleted. Its project and every run and step event went with it.
linkRequests.exported: Export downloaded. No copy is kept on the server.
linkRequests.repoTaken: Another owner already has this repository. The request stays pending.
linkRequests.projectLinked: This project is already linked by another request. The request stays pending.
linkRequests.notPending: This request was already decided. The list now shows its state.
linkRequests.notFound: This request no longer exists. The list is up to date.
linkRequests.failed: The change could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
